# Security standards
<!-- Generated by project-init v0.4.1. Details and reasons: docs/standards/security.md -->

## Enforced
- Keep a visitor's key, scenario and report only in their own `st.session_state`. Never put them in module globals, `st.cache_data`, `st.cache_resource` or anything else shared between sessions.
- Never render scenario text, regeneration feedback or model output with `unsafe_allow_html=True` or `st.html`.
- Never set `server.enableXsrfProtection` or `server.enableCORS` to `false` in `.streamlit/config.toml`.
- The app has no logins. If one is ever added, use OIDC through a proven library or identity provider, and never build authentication or password storage yourself.
- Add and update dependencies only through `uv`, so `uv.lock` and `requirements.txt` stay pinned and in step.

## Adopting
- Before adding a dependency, check that its licence is compatible with MIT. Don't add GPL- or AGPL-licensed packages.
- Review changes that handle visitor input, keys or exported HTML against the OWASP Top 10.
